description: Retrieves articles from report.az (Azerbaijani news site) with Cloudflare bypass handling. Supports article retrieval and search functionality.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_article: Retrieve an article by URL; requires url parameter; 参数: url, max_wait; 必填: url
  - search_articles: Search for articles; requires query parameter; 参数: query, max_wait; 必填: query

url.description: Article URL from report.az (required for get_article function)

max_wait.description:
Maximum seconds to wait for Cloudflare challenge resolution (default 120)
各功能默认值：get_article=180；search_articles=120

query.description: Search query string (required for search_articles function)
